senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (कोलति)
1 To accumulate.
2 To be of kin, to act as of kin.
3 To flow homogeneously.
4 To count.
With आङ् prefixed,
to be attentive;
with वि and आङ्
to be bewildered, flurried or distressed.

n. (-लं)
1 Family, race, tribe or caste.
2 A herd, a flock, &c. of animals of the same species.
3 An inhabited country.
4 A house, an abode.
5 The body.
6 The front or fore part.
7 A blue stone: see कुलत्थ.
m. (-लः)
An artist of celebrated descent.
f. (-लिः or -ली)
A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी, &c.
(-ली)
A wife's elder sister.
E.
कुल to accumulate, क affix, or कुङ् to sound, and लक् affix, or कु the earth, and ल who takes or possesses, from ला with ड aff.

r. 1st cl. (कूलति)
To cover, to hide, to screen, to enclose: with अनु prefixed, to protect, to be kind to, as to a follower or dependant.

n. (-लं)
1 A bank, a shore.
2 A heap, a mound.
3 A pond or pool.
4 The rear of an army.
E.
कूल to cover, अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Of a good family, of eminent birth.
m. (-कः)
1 A species of ebony, (Diospyros tomentosa, Rox.) see काकेन्दु.
2 An artist of eminent birth.
3 An ant or mole hill.
4 A green snake.
n. (-कं)
1 A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes diaeca.)
2 The connexion of several stanzas, protraction of the government of the noun or verb through several verses, contrary to the practice of closing the sense with each verse.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, or कुल race, and क who sounds, declares, &c.

m. (-क्कः)
Beating time in music.

m. (-कः)
An anthill.
n. (-कं)
1 A mound of earth, a heap, a pile.
2 A bank, a dyke.
E.
कन् added to the former.

f. (-न्या)
A girl of good family.
E.
कुल, and कन्या a maiden.

n. (-र्म्म)
The proper duty of a race or family, any observance customarily held by one.
E.
कुल, and कर्म्म act; also कुलक्रिया and कुलकार्य्य.

m. (-यः)
Decay or disappearance of a family.
f. (-या)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
कुल the body, and क्षय injurious.

m. (-रिः)
A mountain, any one of the seven principal mountains of Bhārata Varṣa.
E.
कुल, and गिरि mountain: see कुलाचल.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A thorny plant: see कर्कटशृङ्गी.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Well-born, of a good family.
2 Ancestral, hereditary.
E.
कुल, and ज born; also कुलजात, कुलोत्पन्न, and similar compounds.

m. (-ञ्जः)
See the next.

m. (-नः)
An aromatic plant, (Alpinia galanga); also कुलञ्ज and गन्धमूल.

m. (-टः)
Any son except the one begotten, as one adopted, bought, &c.
f. (-टा)
An unchaste woman.
E.
कुल race, and अट who goes, deriv. irr.; by whom the family honour is injured.

m. (-टः)
A small fish.
E.
कुल for कूल a bank, and अट who goes; burrowing in the sand and mud.

m. (-तिः)
The husband of an unchaste woman, a cuckold.
E.
कुलटा, and पति husband.

f. (-टी)
Red arsenic.

mf. (-थिः)
The fourth, eighth, twelfth, or fourteenth lunar day.
E.
कुल, and तिथि a lunation, respectable days.

m. (-कः)
The chief of a family, one who does honour to a family.
E.
कुल, and तिलक frontal mark.

m. (-त्थः)
A kind of pulse, (Dolichos biflorus.)
f. (-त्था)
1 A blue stone used in medicine, and applied as a collyrium to the eyes; also as an astringent to sores, &c.
2 A wild kind of Dolichos.
E.
कुल a bank, and स्था to stand or stay, affix ड.

f. (-का)
1 A blue stone used as a collyrium, &c.
2 A sort of vetch, considered as a wild sort of the Dolichos biflorus.
E.
see the preceding, कन् added to कुलत्थ in the fem. form.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Practice or observance peculiar to a tribe or family, peculiar duty of caste or race.
E.
कुल family, and धर्म्म virtue.

m. (-कः)
A son.
E.
कुल a race, and धृ to hold, in the causal form, वुन् affix; upholding a family.

m. (-कः)
A son.
E.
see कुलधारक, आङ् being here inserted signifying extension.

n. (-त्रं)
Any propitious asterism.
E.
कुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.

f. (-का)
A girl who is worshipped at the celebration of the orgies of the left hand Śāktas.
E.
कुल society, and नायिका a female.

f. (-री)
A woman of good family.
E.
कुल, and नारी a woman.

m. (-शः)
1 A camel.
2 A reprobate, an outcaste.
E.
कुल a family, नाश who hurts or destroys.

f. (-न्दा)
Family disgrace.
E.
कुल, and निन्दा reproach.

m. (-तिः)
Head or chief of a family.
E.
कुल a family, and पति master.

m. (-तः)
A principal mountain of India, any one of seven so considered: see कुलाचल.
E.
कुल, and पर्ब्वत a mountain; also similar compounds, as कुलगिरि, कुलशैल, &c.

f. (-ला)
An unchaste woman.

mfn. (-लकः-लिका-लकं)
Nourishing or providing for a family.
n. (-कं)
A kind of orange.
E.
कुल a race, &c. पाल to nourish, and वुन् aff.

f. (-लिः)
A chaste woman.
E.
कुल race, and पाल who nourishes, इन् fem. affix; also कुलपालिका and कुलपाली.

f. (-का)
See कुलपालि.

f. (-धूः)
A virtuous or respectable woman.
E.
कुल, and बधू a wife.

f. (-त्या)
A midwife, a nurse.
E.
कुल family, and भृत्या a servant.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Expelled from a family.
E.
कुल, and भ्रष्ट fallen from.

f. (-दा)
Family honour or respectability.
E.
कुल, and मर्य्यादा propriety.

m. (-त्रं)
A friend of the family.
E.
कुल, and मित्र a friend.

m. (-रः)
A thief: see कुजम्भल.

f. (-त्)
A virtuous woman.
E.
कुल, and योषित् a woman.

m. (-रः)
Tuesday or Friday.
E.
कुल, and वार a day.

m. (-प्रः)
The family priest.
E.
कुल race, and विप्र a Brahman.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Attaching or applicable to tribe or caste.
E.
कुल, and व्यापिन् prevailing.

mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि)
1 An artificer or artist of eminent birth.
2 Well-born, of good family.
3 Eminent in a family.
E.
कुल race, and श्रेष्ठ best, poss. affix इनि.

f. (-ङ्ख्या)
Ranking or being reckoned as a family, family respectability.
E.
कुल, and सङ्ख्या enumeration.

f. (-तिः)
Posterity, descendants.
E.
कुल, and सन्तति continuance.

f. (-धिः)
1 Kindred, relations.
2 Presence of witnesses.
E.
कुल, and सन्निधि proximity.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Sprung from family.
E.
कुल race, and सम्भव born, produced.

n. (-भं)
A plant, commonly Marüa: see मरुवक.

f. (-तिः)
Antiquity or prosperity of a family.
E.
कुल, and स्थिति duration.

f. (-स्त्री)
1 A chaste woman.
2 A woman of a good family, a respectable woman.
E.
कुल a family, and स्त्री a woman.

m. (-कः)
An eddy: see कूलहण्डक.

m. (-कः)
An eddy.
E.
कूल a bank, and हुडि to collect, वुन् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of mixed origin of a mixed character.
E.
कुल propitious, and आकुल bewildered, or कुल with a neg. prefix.

mf. (-थिः)
The second, sixth or tenth lunar days.
E.
कुलाकुल, and तिथि a lunation.

n. (-त्रं)
An asterism of mixed character, as Vāruṇī, Ārdrā, Mūla and Abhijit.
E.
कुलाकुल, and नक्षत्र asterism.

m. (-रः)
Wednesday.
E.
कुलाकुल, and वार a day.

f. (-ता)
A bitch.

m. (-लः)
A mountain, one of a class of seven principal mountains, which are supposed to exist in each Varṣa or division of a continent: those of Bhārata Varṣa or India are Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Śuktimān, Ṛkṣa, Vindhya, and Pāripātra.
E.
कुल a race, and अचल a mountain; also कुलाद्रि, &c.

m. (-रः)
The proper duty or practice of a caste or family.
E.
कुल, and आचार observance.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Frequenting the banks of rivers, grazing there, &c.
E.
कूल, चर what goes.

m. (-र्य्यः)
1 A family priest.
2 A genealogist.
E.
कुल, and आचार्य्य teacher.

m. (-भिः)
A treasure.

n. (-नं)
Pride of birth, family pride.
E.
कुल, and अभिमान pride.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Proud of birth or of family descent.
E.
कुल, and अमिमानिन् proud.

m. (-यः)
1 A nest.
2 A place, a spot in general.
n. (-यं)
The body.
E.
कुल family, and अय to go, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Sitting in a nest, brooding.
E.
कुलाय, and निलाय abiding.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Brooding, hatching, (as a bird.)
E.
कुलाय, and निलायिन् who abides in.

f. (-ता)
The act or condition of hatching, &c.
E.
तल् added to the last.

m. (-स्थः)
A bird.
E.
कुलाय a nest, and स्थ who abides.

f. (-का)
An aviary.
E.
कुलाय a nest, and कन् affix in the fem. form.

m. (-लः)
1 A potter.
2 A wild cock.
f. (-ली)
A species of blue stone^1, applied as a collyrium to the eyes.
2 The wife of a potter.
E.
कुल to accumulate, and कालन Uṇādi affix, or कुल family, अल to adorn, &c. अण् and ङीप् or ङीष् affs.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-म्बी-म्बिनी-म्बि)
Supporting or maintaining a family.
E.
कुल, and आलम्बिन् what upholds.

f. (-का)
An aviary.

m. (-हः)
A horse of a light brown colour, with black knees.

m. (-लः)
A small tree, (Conyza terebinthina.)

m. (-कः)
A chamelion.

m. (-लिः)
A hand.
f. (-लिः)
A prickly nightshade: see कुल.
E.
कुल to accumulate, &c. कि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Of a good family, well-born.
m. (-कः)
One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent race, described as having a half moon on the top of his head, and being of a monkey hue.
2 An artist or artificer of eminent birth.
3 A thorny plant, (Ruellia longifolia.)
4 The chief or headman of a tribe or caste.
E.
कुल family, &c. कन् affix, and इ substituted for अ.

f. (-का)
Base or bottom part of the Indian lute.

f. (-ला)
Certain portions of each day, on which it is improper to begin any business.
E.
कुलिक, and वेला time.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The fork-tailed shrike; also कलिङ्ग.

m. (-कः)
A sparrow.

m. (-रः)
A crab; also कुलीर.

mf. (-रः-रं)
A crab.
E.
कुल to accumulate, and ईरन् affix; also कुलिर.

mn. (-शः-शं)
1 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
2 A kind of fish.
E.
कुलि for कुल a bank, and श what rests, from शीङ्^1 to sleep. &c. and क aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mn. (-शः-शं)
INDRA'S thunderbolt: see कुलिश.

m. (-भृत्)
INDRA.
E.
कुलिश, and भृत् who has.

f. (-शा)
A kind of female deity.
E.
कुलिश the thunderbolt, and अङ्कुश a goad.

m. (-नः)
A name of Śākya, a Buddha or Bauddha saint.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Well-born, of high or eminent descent, of a good family.
m. (-नः)
1 A horse of a good breed.
2 A Brahman of one of the twenty-two Rārhiya divisions of the five principal tribes, as established by Balāl Sen king of Beṅgal.
3 A worshipper of ŚAKTI, according to the left hand ritual: see कौलीन.
E.
कुल a family, and ख aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Of a good family.
m. (-कः)
A kind of wild kidney bean.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ता)
Birth, rank, family respectability.
E.
कुलीन, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कुलीनत्वं.

n. (-सं)
Water.

f. (-ङ्गी)
A plant: see कर्क्कटशृङ्गी.

m. (-द् or त्)
A young crab.
E.
कुलीर a crab, and अद to eat, affix क्विप्; destroying its parent; the old crab being supposed to perish on producing young.

n. (-कं)
The fur or foulness of the tongue.
E.
कुल to accumulate, and उक aff.

f. (-ञ्जा)
A firebrand.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 The chief of a family or race.
E.
कुल a race, ईश्वर lord.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
High-born.
m. (-टः)
A horse of a good breed.
E.
कुल race, and उत्कट eminent.

m. (-र्षः)
Family respectability.
E.
कुल, and उत्कर्ष excellence.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Of good family.
E.
कुल, and उद्गत exalted.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Of a good family, well-born.
2 Family, belonging to, inherited by, &c.
E.
कुल, and उत्पन्न born.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Well-born, of good family.
2 Produced in a family.
E.
कुल, and उद्भव birth.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well-born, of family.
E.
कुल, and उद्भूत born.

m. (-हः)
A chief, a leader, the head of a family.
E.
कुल, and उद्वह who upholds.

mn. (-ल्फः-ल्फं)
A disease.
m. (-ल्फः)
The ancle; also गुल्फ.
E.
कल to count, फ Uṇādi affix, and उ inserted.

n. (-लं)
Sin.
E.
कुष to extract, क्मलन् Uṇādi affix, and ष changed to ल.

mn. (-षः-षं)
Sour gruel prepared by the spontaneous fermentation of the water of boiled rice.
n. (-षं)
1 Half ripe barley.
2 Forced rice.
3 A sort of Phaseolus: see राजमाष.
4 A species of Dolichos, (D. biflorus.) see यावक.
5 A disease.
m. (-षः)
A dish consisting of half boiled rice, with pulse, &c. commonly Khicri.
E.
कुल a class or race, मष or मस to hurt or kill, अण् affix; hence the word is also written कुल्मास.

mn. (-सः-सं)
See कुल्माष.

n. (-तं)
Sour gruel. see कुल्मास.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 Of a good family, well-born, well descended.
2 Of or relating to a family or race.
m. (-ल्यः)
A counsellor.
f. (-ल्या)
1 A river in general.
2 A canal, a channel for irrigation.
3 A ditch, a dyke or trench.
4 A drug or medicinal plant, (Celtis orientalis): see जीवन्ती.
5 A chaste or virtuous woman.
n. (-ल्यं)
1 A bone.
2 A measure of eight Droṇas: see द्रोण.
3 A winnowing basket.
4 Flesh.
5 Friendly inquiry after family affairs or domestic accidents, condolence, congratulation, &c.
E.
कुल to accumulate, and यत् affix, &c.

n. (-कः)
Fur upon the tongue.

m. (-षः)
1 The ocean, the sea.
2 The stream or current of a river.
f. (-षा)
A river.
E.
कूल a bank, कष to injure, affix स्वच्.

f. (-भूः)
A bank, the land upon the bank or shore.
E.
कूल, and भू earth.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Breaking down banks (as a river, &c.)
E.
कूल, रुज to make sick, with उत् pre. and खश aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Carrying away the banks, (a river, &c.)
E.
कूल, वह to bear, उत् pre. खश् aff.

f. (-ती)
A river.
E.
कूल a bank, and मतुप् poss. affix, fem. ङीष्.
